description: Wait for the answer to a request_urgent_help you already created — for callers WITHOUT a runner session, which are never woken up on their own. One call blocks for at most 240 seconds (default 50); if the answer has not arrived yet it returns weiter_warten: true and you simply repeat the SAME call with the same request_id — the request itself stays alive until its own deadline. Returns answer 'Erledigt' (retry the blocked step now), 'Abgelehnt' (end that part with this reason) or 'Frist abgelaufen — niemand hat geantwortet'. Read-only. Required: request_id.

wait_seconds.description: Wartezeit dieses einen Aufrufs, Vorgabe 50, hoechstens 240.

name: wait_for_urgent_help
